title: 第2888章 江尘归来狗兔子装逼第2887章 高层商议为何未归
lines: 殿内此刻忽然出现的声音，顿时令众人神色一震。
下一刻，大殿门口，一行人出现在空地中。
为首的自然便是江尘了。
其身后分别跟着狗兔子与净尘。
另外还有三位身穿灰袍掩盖身形的男人。
当这一行人出现后，在场的诸位高层感受到几人的修为以及散发出的气息，皆是神色变幻。
“宗，宗主，您的气息！”
一位修为足有六劫虚仙的老人，此刻神色间满是震惊，看向江尘愕然开口。
如果他没记错的话，离开宗门之时，江尘明明只是一劫虚仙，但如今归来后已然达到了六劫。
而江尘离开的这段时日，满打满算也不过半月。
短短半月时间就已经达到六劫虚仙，这是何等恐怖的速度！
而此时发现这一点的，也不仅仅是这位长老，凡是在场的诸位高层皆是神色震惊。
哪怕是那些修为不及江尘的，在发现自己已经无法看透江尘修为的时候，便已经明白了一切。
最震惊的当属凰云霓。
她身形一闪，瞬间上前，上下打量着江尘，差点都要怀疑眼前这人究竟是不是自己的相公了。
“江尘，你成功了？”
凰云霓疑声问道。
相比起修为，此时她更疑惑的，是江尘的气息。
如今江尘的气息，远远不止六劫虚仙那么简单。
仅仅只是散发出的一部分，就令她感到恍若有一只远古凶兽站在面前，令人不由得感到战栗。
那是一种自根源上的碾压，而造成的气息与血脉压制。
这样的感受，曾经她即便在凤凰一族的族长身上也从未感到过。
眼看着自己的爱人江尘直接牵住了凰云霓的手，神色温柔，语气温和道：“不错，我成功了。”
“这段时间，我前往佛国之后，成功找到了古佛舍利，令实力大增。”
“之后又收服了流落在神弃之地的仙品异火，这才提升到了六劫虚仙之境。”
在场的诸多高层都是向大道立过誓的，因此都是可以完全信任的手下，所以江尘便也没有在众人面前隐瞒过什么。
而随着他这一番信息量巨大的话语出口，顿时令在场本就灼烈的气氛再次轰动。
“什，什么？宗主还收服了仙品异火？而且还是流落在神弃之地的？”
“短短不到半月，宗主竟有如此精彩的经历。”
“那可是仙品异种元素，据说即便是历代十大圣地的顶级强者，也从未有人成功过，任何一个敢于尝试的人，最终都会身死道消，毫无例外，久而久之，也就没人敢尝试了，宗主是如何做到的？”
“是啊，仙品异种元素可是仙界之物，绝非我等凡人能够收服的，宗主，果然不愧是宗主。”
“有了仙品异火在身，宗主定然已成当世第一强者！”
“哈哈哈哈，看来，天魔一族再也无法形成威胁了，宗主有仙品异火在身，即便天魔一族各路魔主齐上阵，也定然不是宗主的对手。”
此时此刻，在短短的时间内，在场的太一宗高层，很快就从震惊、释然、再转为惊喜。
这一连串的情绪，使得他们很快就消化了江尘所说出的信息量。
而最让他们惊喜的，无疑是江尘收服了仙品异火之事了。
content_en:
The sound that suddenly appeared in the hall at this moment made everyone look shocked.
The next moment, a group of people appeared in the open space at the entrance of the hall.
The leader is naturally Jiang Chen.
Behind them were Dog, Rabbit and Jingchen.
There were also three men wearing gray robes to hide their figures.
When this group of people appeared, the expressions of the senior officials present changed as they felt their cultivation and auras.
"Zong, sect master, your breath!"
An old man with a cultivation level of Six Tribulations of Immortal, his expression was full of shock at this moment, he looked at Jiang Chen and spoke in astonishment.
If he remembered correctly, when he left the sect, Jiang Chen was clearly a virtual immortal of one calamity, but now he has reached six calamities after returning.
And the period of time Jiang Chen left was only half a month.
In just half a month, he has reached the level of Six Tribulations Void Immortal. What a terrifying speed!
At this time, it was not just this elder who discovered this, but all the senior officials present looked shocked.
Even those whose cultivation was not as good as Jiang Chen's, already understood everything when they realized that they could no longer see through Jiang Chen's cultivation.
The most shocked person was undoubtedly Huang Yunni.
She stepped forward in a flash and looked Jiang Chen up and down, almost doubting whether the man in front of her was her husband-in-law.
"Jiang Chen, did you succeed?"
Huang Yunni asked suspiciously.
Compared to his cultivation, what she was more confused about at this time was Jiang Chen's aura.
Now Jiang Chen's aura is far more than just a Six Tribulations Void Immortal.
Just a part of it made her feel as if there was an ancient ferocious beast standing in front of her, which made people shudder.
It was a kind of crushing from the source, resulting in the suppression of breath and blood.
She had never felt such a feeling before, even with the leader of the Phoenix clan.
Seeing his lover Jiang Chen directly holding Huang Yunni's hand, he looked gentle and said in a gentle tone: "Yes, I succeeded."
"During this period, after I went to the Buddhist Kingdom, I successfully found the ancient Buddha relics, which greatly increased my strength."
"After that, I conquered the immortal fires that were wandering in the land abandoned by the gods, and then I was promoted to the realm of Six Tribulations Void Immortal."
Many of the high-level officials present had sworn an oath to Da Dao, so they were all subordinates who could be completely trusted, so Jiang Chen did not hide anything in front of everyone.
And as his words with a huge amount of information came out, the already intense atmosphere was once again stirred up.
"Wha, what? The sect master also subdued the immortal fire? And he is still living in the land abandoned by the gods?"
"In less than half a month, the sect leader had such a wonderful experience."
"That is a fairy-grade alien element. It is said that even among the top experts in the ten holy places in the past, no one has ever succeeded. Anyone who dares to try will eventually die without exception. Over time, no one dares to try. How did the sect master do it?"
"That's right. Immortal-grade exotic elements are things from the Immortal Realm. They are definitely not something that mortals like us can conquer. Sect Master, you are indeed worthy of being the Sect Master."
"With the immortal fire in his body, the sect leader will definitely become the most powerful person in the world!"
"Hahahaha, it seems that the Heavenly Demon clan can no longer pose a threat. The sect master has the immortal fire. Even if all the demon lords of the Heavenly Demon clan come together to fight, they will definitely not be the sect leader's opponent."
At this moment, in a short period of time, the senior officials of Taiyi Sect present quickly changed from shock, relief, to surprise.
This series of emotions allowed them to quickly digest the amount of information Jiang Chen said.
What surprised them the most was undoubtedly Jiang Chen's ability to conquer the immortal fire.
title_en: Chapter 2888 When Jiang Chen returns, the dog and rabbit show off. Chapter 2887 The top management discussed why he did not return.
